jobs.title: Senior Alternative Investment Wholesaler
jobs.description:
We at Bridge acknowledge and appreciate the uniqueness of each individual, understanding that our people are the key to our success. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels respected and valued. Our dedication extends beyond our business goals to making a positive impact in our communities and upholding Sustainability and Responsibility (S&R) principles at our properties and corporate locations. We evaluate all candidates based on merit, without any discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, national origin, or any other category protected by law. As an equal opportunity employer, we are devoted to creating an inclusive hiring process. We actively work to eliminate barriers and provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Our goal is to provide fair opportunities and access throughout the recruitment, hiring, and employment experience. Your specific needs are important to us. If you need accommodations related to a disability or any other protected status during the recruitment process, please inform us.

Make an impact

The (West/East/Etc.) Senior Alternative Investment Wholesaler will drive fundraising results across the full suite of Bridge plus Apollo’s Real Estate product suite, with a focus on the major Wirehouses, Registered Investment Advisor (RIA) and Independent Broker Dealer (IBD) client segments. The (West/East/Etc.) Real Estate Senior Wholesaler will focus their coverage on the top RIAs in their region, as well as partner with the US Wealth National Accounts team on Strategic Relationships across RIAs, IBDs, TAMPs and OCIOs. In instances where product is on the platforms of major Wirehouses, that FA penetration will become a major area of focus. This individual will have a deep, consistent track record of driving commercial outcomes, paired with key relationships across assigned region/territory.

The (West/East/Etc.) Senior Alternative Investment Wholesaler will champion the continual growth of the firm’s market share by supporting all aspects of the sales cycle from prospecting, to closing business to asset retention. This prioritizes the coverage of regional teams of Financial Advisors of firms where products have been approved to drive deeper adoption. In the near term, there will be significant focus on 1031 distribution. The role should also plan on partnering with the investment organizations broadly to communicate and provide detailed technical expertise on investment strategies and how such strategies can be implemented within client firm platforms and models.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drive fundraising across the full Real Estate product suite, focused on a specific region/territory of advisors/firms under their coverage.
  • Deep understanding of the factors that drive wealth sales, especially tax, yield and liquidity implications.
  • Deep knowledge of and experience distributing DST/1031 solutions to clients.
  • Develops and executes sales plans to increase sales revenue and market share within assigned firms/institutions.
  • Position the suite of Real Estate strategies in a highly commercial and impactful manner with financial advisors in the coverage region/territory.
  • Penetrate specific target opportunities within the region to capitalize on strength and differentiation of Real Estate offerings and to implement sales campaigns.
  • Collaborate closely with internal partners across the firm to cultivate a deep understanding of the investment approach and results to represent all facets of the firm’s products internally and externally.
  • Develop and deliver investment, market, and business communications to existing and prospective clients in one-on-one, small group, and large audience presentations.
  • Provide updates on overall financial markets performance, economic trends, and the overall investment outlook.
  • Act as a spokesperson for the investment team with the ability to present a deep understanding of the investment process, market outlook, and strong advocate for the services.
  • Utilizes expense budgets to set limits and maximize sales opportunities within his/her assigned territory.
  • Maintains sales call data in appropriate systems and/or complete sales reports.
  • Maintains knowledge on current and emerging developments/trends for assigned area(s) of responsibility, assesses the impact, and collaborates with management to incorporate new trends and developments in current and future solutions.
  • Work closely with other internal departments, including Marketing, Product Management, CPMs, etc to ensure impactful marketing materials are being created to reach prospects/clients.
  • Significant travel is required, with an expectation of 80% of the time being on the road.

What to bring

  • Minimum 10 years working in financial services with prior experience serving in a private wealth distribution role.
  • Proficiency and track record in successful Real Estate sales including but not limited to Private REITs, Interval Funds, DSTs and closed-end drawdown Real Estate offerings.
  • Significant relationships with high value advisors in the RIA and IBD channels in given territory, with a proven track record of raising assets.
  • Demonstrated ability and commitment to a team focused approach to achieving individual, group, and business goals.
  • Sales and relationship-building acumen – ability to influence advisor decisions at point of sale.
  • Execute from sales process and business plan.
  • Deep knowledge of economics and capital markets, including global macro and marketing topics, paired with strong investment acumen.
  • Proven excellent verbal and written communication skills with ability to convey information to internal and external customers in a clear, focused, and concise manner.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively interact and communicate with all levels of staff and management.
  • Demonstrated experience maintaining a calm and professional demeanor when handling demanding situations, such as prioritizing multiple tasks with critical target dates, dealing with demanding customers and participating in discussions with limited preparation time.
  • Must be able to cite examples from work experience on identifying complex problems, quantifying the problem, and providing resolutions to solve.
  • Demonstrated strong results orientation. Must cite examples of situations where a strong results orientation was demonstrated.

Qualifications And Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a finance-related field.
  • Proficient in word processing, spreadsheet, and presentation applications.
  • Working knowledge of database and web-based applications, with a priority towards tools used to execute Wealth sales.
  • FINRA Series 7 and 66 Licenses required (24 may be required)
  • Preference for investment industry designations (e.g., CFA, CIMA, CFP, CAIA).


What you can be apart of

Bridge’s Client Solutions Group (CSG) works directly with some of the largest and most sophisticated investors in the world including US and International corporate and public pensions, sovereign wealth funds, insurance companies, family offices and major wealth platforms. The team is responsible for raising capital across Bridge’s investment verticals, managing communications with current and prospective investors, and marketing the firm and its strategies.

Compensation Details

The anticipated wage scale is $240,000-340,000 per year. The hired applicant will also be eligible for an annual performance based discretionary bonus. The final pay offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to the type and years of experience within the job, the type of years and experience within the industry, education, etc. Bridge Investment Group is a multi-state employer, and this pay scale may not reflect positions that work in other states or locations.

What we offer

  • Full Insurance benefit suite including Medical Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accident Insurance, Short Term Disability, Legal & Identity Theft Insurance, and Pet Insurance.
  • Company paid Life Insurance (option to buy additional available) and Long-Term Disability.
  • Access to benefits concierge service.
  • Access to Mental Health & Well-Being service.
  • Cell Phone Reimbursement: You will be provided a mobile phone allowance of $30 per month.
  • 401K: Bridge Investment Group will match your contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to 6% of your pay. These contributions are fully vested immediately. Eligible employees are automatically enrolled at a 4% contribution rate. *The employee must be at least 21 years of age and have worked for the Company for at least 60 days.
  • Vacation Time: Employee will accrue 3.38 hours of paid time off per pay period for a total of 17 days per year.
  • 11 Paid Holidays per year.
  • Sick Time: You will accrue 1 hour of sick time for every 30 hours worked with a cap of 48 hours.

jobs.description:
2026 Special Executions Group – Experienced Associate (NY)

Position:Financial Technology Partners (“FT Partners”) is seeking an Experienced Associate for its Special Executions Group (“SpecialX”).

Firm Overview

FT Partners is a leading boutique investment bank exclusively focused on the Financial Technology sector. Headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York and London, the firm has advised on many of the most significant and high-profile transactions in global FinTech.

FT Partners provides a full suite of strategic advisory services, including M&A advisory, private capital raising, and capital markets advisory. With a 250+ banker global platform, the firm is widely recognized as the dominant advisor in one of the most dynamic and high-growth industry sectors. FT Partners combines senior-level attention, execution excellence, and unmatched sector expertise to deliver superlative outcomes for high-growth and scaled market leaders alike.

Role Description

  • SpecialX is FT Partners’ dedicated financial and strategic execution arm. We work alongside the investment banking teams, but our focus is distinct: ensuring that financial analysis, growth positioning, and investor materials are fully prepared to withstand sophisticated private equity and strategic buyer scrutiny.
  • This is an oversight-heavy, forward-looking role at the center of live transactions. The Associate will help shape how high-growth FinTech companies articulate and defend their growth story to the most sophisticated investors in the market. Rather than simply analyzing performance, this role advises on how growth should be projected, how risks should be framed, and how the financial narrative is constructed to align with how investors underwrite businesses. It requires strong financial judgment, intellectual confidence, and the ability to move seamlessly between detailed execution and strategic advisory.
  • The Associate will work directly with senior bankers and firm leadership, gaining meaningful exposure to transaction strategy and investor positioning at the highest levels.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own critical financial and growth workstreams across live deals, including revenue quality, cohort & retention analysis, unit economics, sales efficiency, and growth validation
  • Advise bankers and management teams on how growth should be modeled, projected, and defended in front of sophisticated investors
  • Identify and frame the key issues that will drive investor scrutiny, surfacing risks and shaping mitigation strategies before diligence begins
  • Operate with visibility across multiple transactions, balancing deep execution on select deals with high-level oversight across broader live activity
  • Set and reinforce high standards of analytical rigor and investor-grade thinking across the team, including mentorship of junior professionals
  • Help strengthen and institutionalize SpecialX as a differentiated strategic capability within FT Partners

General Qualifications

  • Major in finance, accounting, economics, or related field required
  • Advanced degree and / or professional qualifications strongly preferred (e.g., MSc, MBA, CPA, CFA)
  • Minimum of 5 – 8 years of experience in transaction services, financial due diligence (FDD / QoE), or high-growth corporate finance roles strongly preferred
  • SaaS / Tech or FinTech experience strongly preferred (either as sector specialization within consulting or strategic finance roles within industry)
  • Permanent U.S. work authorization required. FT Partners will not sponsor applicants for work visas at application or in the future

Business and Technical Skills

  • Strong grounding in financial diligence, revenue quality analysis, forecasting, and core accounting concepts required
  • Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint
  • Excellent problem-solving ability and intellectual curiosity
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy

Communications

  • Ability to build and foster relationships with senior team members, investment bankers, and clients
  • Exceptional writing and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple high priority tasks and initiatives
  • Prepares high impact materials
  • Seamlessly leads both internal and external meetings

Team Player

  • Experience with managing, coaching, and leading work of junior team members
  • Able to collaborate across teams and levels, both internally and externally
  • Builds trusted relationships with all team members and senior stakeholders
  • High-level of engagement and commitment to the firm's goals and organizational success
  • Self-motivated and entrepreneurial

Why FT Partners?

  • Managing Partner and Managing Directors formerly of Goldman Sachs, JP Morgan, Evercore and Barclays
  • Award-winning execution; Investment Bank of the Year / Boutique of the Year Awards (among many others)
  • Executing both billion-dollar and early-stage / high-growth transactions
  • Excellent career path, strong and competitive compensation
  • Unparalleled deal flow with premier client base
  • Access to world-class executives at high-growth companies
  • Dominant footprint in one of largest sectors: financial technology
  • Top-notch financial sponsor relationships
  • Close-knit, rapidly growing team 

Selected transactions include advising:

  • Deribit’s $4.3 billion Sale to Coinbase
  • Divvy's $2.5 billion Sale to Bill.com
  • AvidXchange’s $2.2 billion Sale to TPG & Corpay

jobs.title: Financing Specialist
jobs.description:
About the Position

We are looking for a financing professional to support and develop Jane Street's APAC financing capabilities across multiple asset classes. To thrive in this role, you’ll need prior experience developing financing solutions at a bank, broker-dealer or buy-side firm and strong relationships with prime brokers and counterparties across the spectrum of APAC markets and financing structures.

This role is entrepreneurial—it offers the opportunity to collaborate on immediate trading decisions and develop the firm's longer-term financing strategy. In doing so, you can expect to work with a broad range of internal teams to understand and manage the various constraints of a quantitative trading firm. Additional responsibilities of the role will include:

  • Optimising our financing capacity: improving access to inventory, identifying inefficiencies in our workflows, reducing costs
  • Collaborating across our trading desks on real-time and strategic trading decisions
  • Maintaining and developing relationships with prime brokers and other external financing counterparties
  • Helping to form our longer-term financing strategy by improving and expanding our financing activity
  • Understanding our firmwide financing constraints and comparing financing opportunities using in-depth cost-benefit analysis
  • Applying your technical skills to help build and improve infrastructure supporting our financing workflows and initiatives

About You

  • Have 3-7 years of related securities financing experience at a bank or buy-side firm
  • Have a strong understanding of Asian market microstructure and mechanics, financing and stock loan markets; having experience across multiple asset classes and financing structures is a plus
  • Have a strong understanding and appreciation of risk and risk consequences in the context of Asian markets and products
  • Excited and able to cultivate and manage relationships with prime brokers and other clearing, execution, and financing counterparties
  • Have strong analytical skills and experience performing technical data analysis to solve problems 
  • Intellectually curious and motivated to learn about how the financing role fits into other areas of the firm
  • An effective communicator who works well in a team environment
  • Fluency in Python, SQL or other programming languages is a strong plus
  • Fluent in English

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com

jobs.title: General Consideration
jobs.description:
Adams Street Partners (“Adams Street”) is a global private markets investment manager that has nearly $73 billion* in assets under management. The firm is 100% employee-owned, which fosters a positive and unique culture of collaboration, intellectual rigor, integrity, and a commitment to professional development. For the eighth year in a row, Adams Street was named one of Pension & Investments’ Best Places to Work in Money Management in 2025. 

Employees operate as a single global team, integrating the expertise of the firm’s investment professionals across five strategies: primary investments, secondary investments, growth equity, private credit, and co-investments.  Adams Street is considered a private markets pioneer and was inducted into the Private Equity Hall of Fame in 2000.

The firm was founded more than 50 years ago, and clients include leading public and corporate pension plans, foundations, endowments, insurance companies, registered investment advisors, and high net worth individuals worldwide.

Adams Street has offices in Abu Dhabi, Austin, Beijing, Boston, Chicago, Hong Kong, London, Munich, Menlo Park, New York, Seoul, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo and Toronto.

*As of December 31, 2025. Adams Street Partners’ methodology to calculate Assets Under Management (AUM) is based on fund net asset value (NAV), plus unfunded commitments, plus leverage, but excluding the effect of subscription lines of credit. The prior AUM methodology was based on investor commitments minus commitments to fully liquidated underlying partnerships. Such change in methodology was effective July 2026; however, for periods shown prior to December 31, 2025, Adams Street continues to use the previous methodology. This updated methodology more closely aligns with (i) the amount of assets managed on behalf of investors and (ii) the amount of capital available to make direct and/or partnership investments. Amounts stated by investment advisers in regulatory filings (“regulatory AUM”) have a prescribed methodology, which may, in some circumstances, differ from the methodology such adviser uses for other purposes, including marketing efforts. Additional information is available upon request.

Please share your resume to be considered for future openings.

jobs.description:
About Invesco

As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

What’s in it for you?

Our people are at the very core of our success. Invesco employees get more out of life through our comprehensive compensation and benefit offerings including:

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Hybrid work schedule 

  • 401(K) matching of 100% up to the first 6% with a discretionary supplemental contribution 

  • Health & wellbeing benefits 

  • Parental Leave benefits 

  • Employee stock purchase plan

Job Description

About the Role:

Invesco is seeking a Product Manager to support a range of investment strategies within its Fundamental Equities franchise, part of the Americas Product Management team. The platform manages $281B in assets with 110+ professionals across 7 global locations, delivering 70 equity strategies to clients in 25+ countries across retail and institutional segments. This role is responsible for developing and maintaining high-quality sales and marketing content, reporting, and product initiatives that support business growth across distribution channels. The Product Manager serves as a key liaison between portfolio teams, client portfolio managers, and cross-functional partners to ensure alignment on product positioning, messaging, and commercial priorities. Success in this role requires deep expertise in equity strategies, strong market awareness, and advanced skills in analytics, communication, and relationship management.

Responsibilities of the role:

  • Lead month- and quarter-end updates of product collateral, including presentations, factsheets, commentaries, infographics, annual reports, and risk/performance attribution reporting
  • Partner cross-functionally (legal, compliance, risk, technology, sales, and marketing) to ensure compliant, high-quality product messaging is reviewed, approved, and delivered on time
  • Support regulatory and governance requirements, including fund board materials, prospectus/SAI reviews, and ongoing reporting deliverables
  • Serve as a key resource for marketing and RFP teams by maintaining accurate product data, managing consultant databases, and supporting RFP/DDQ content and positioning
  • Ensure quality control across product websites and internal platforms, maintaining accurate, current, and compliant content
  • Coordinate product change management efforts, aligning stakeholders and ensuring timely updates across systems and client communications
  • Partner closely with CPMs and investment teams to drive alignment across product, distribution, and marketing, while building deep expertise in strategies and portfolio performance
  • Deliver insights and support business development through marketing materials, sales enablement, client communications, and competitive analysis using tools such as Morningstar and eVestment

Requirements of the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in financial services, preferably within asset management

jobs.title: Assistant Product Manager Institutional Lending, Pricing & ESG - 12 Month Contract
jobs.description:
See Yourself in Our Team 

Capital Structuring (Cap S) provides the core product, pricing and governance infrastructure that supports lending activities across Institutional Banking & Markets (IB&M) and Business Banking. 

The Pricing & ESG Product Management team manages and evolves DPX, a strategic platform that supports relationship pricing, return on capital assessment and Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) decisioning across the lending lifecycle. We partner closely with bankers, technology teams, risk, operations and external vendors to deliver efficient, well-governed and customer-focused outcomes. 

Do Work That Matters 

As an Assistant Product Manager, you will support the day-to-day operation and ongoing enhancement of DPX, the strategic Pricing and ESG platform used across Institutional Banking & Markets and Business Banking. 

This 12-month contract role offers a unique opportunity to combine operational management, stakeholder engagement, business support and change delivery while contributing to the continuous improvement of critical lending capabilities.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Key point of contact for operational activities, partnering with bankers, pricing teams, technology teams and external vendors to ensure DPX remains reliable, well governed and fit for purpose. 

  • Partner with business, technology and vendor teams to coordinate production support, platform enhancements and change initiatives.

  • Assist Product Owners with backlog management, prioritisation and delivery planning to support strategic objectives.

  • Contribute to testing, release and business readiness activities for new features and enhancements.

  • Monitor operational performance and identify opportunities to improve processes through automation, AI and smarter ways of working.

  • Maintain operational documentation, business rules and governance controls, supporting risk, compliance and audit requirements.

  • Build strong stakeholder relationships and help drive continuous improvement across pricing and ESG capabilities.

We're Interested in Hearing From People Who:

  • Have experience supporting operational processes, products or platforms within banking or financial services. 

  • Demonstrate strong stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills. 

  • Possess excellent written and verbal communication skills. 

  • Demonstrate strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capability. 

  • Have an interest in emerging technologies, AI and automation, and how they can be applied to improve business and customer outcomes. 

  • Enjoy working collaboratively across business, technology, operations and risk teams and can effectively balance operational priorities with delivery commitments. 

  • Understanding of Institutional Banking, Business Banking or lending products is highly desirable

  • Exposure to pricing, return on capital frameworks or ESG-related processes is highly desirable

Help shape the future of pricing and ESG capabilities across IB&M and Business Banking while building valuable product management experience in a high-impact environment. If you're a collaborative problem solver who enjoys working at the intersection of business, technology, and operations, we'd love to hear from you.

If you're already part of the Commonwealth Bank Group (including Bankwest, x15ventures), you'll need to apply through Sidekick to submit a valid application. We’re keen to support you with the next step in your career.

We're aware of some accessibility issues on this site, particularly for screen reader users. We want to make finding your dream job as easy as possible, so if you require additional support please contact HR Direct on 1800 989 696.
